# E0607: the CUE module requires a version of thema's CUE other than the one this program embeds

The cue.mod/module.cue above the lineage depends on a version of thema's
CUE module other than the one this program embeds. thema's CLI resolves
github.com/sdboyer/thema to its own embedded copy, and only to that; the help
names the version to declare.

## Example

`mod/cue.mod/module.cue`:

```cue
module: "example.com/skew"
language: version: "v0.9.0"
deps: "github.com/sdboyer/thema@v0": {v: "v0.0.1"}
```

`mod/x.cue`:

```cue
package x

import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"

lin: thema.Lineage & {
	name: "x"
	schemas: {
		"0": {
			"0": {
				schema: {
					a: string
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"a": "Argo"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0607]: the CUE module requires thema v0.0.1, but this program embeds v0.1.0
 --> mod/x.cue:3:8
  |
3 | import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: set deps["github.com/sdboyer/thema@v0"].v to "v0.1.0" in cue.mod/module.cue
```
